title: Implement a Trie
description: A trie (pronounced as 'try') or prefix tree is a tree data structure used to store and retrieve keys in a string dataset. Operations: `INSERT word`, `SEARCH word`, `STARTSWITH prefix`.
input_format: First line contains integer `m`. Following `m` lines contain operations.
output_format: Space-separated outputs of SEARCH and STARTSWITH commands (true/false).

sample_tests.input:
5
INSERT apple
SEARCH apple
SEARCH app
STARTSWITH app
INSERT app
sample_tests.explanation: apple found, app not yet inserted, startsWith app is true.

sample_tests.input:
3
INSERT cat
SEARCH cat
STARTSWITH ca

hidden_tests.input:
4
INSERT hello
SEARCH he
STARTSWITH he
SEARCH hello

hints: Represent Trie nodes with nested hash maps or an array of 26 child pointers.
Mark the end of a word with a special sentinel key like '#'.
Searching traverses the word and checks for the end sentinel; startsWith only requires that the path exists.
